mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces expected corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 8.0 and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 8% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% signals improving manufacturing activity and earnings momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month MA by >2% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over three months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% over three months signals strengthening labor demand and earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month MA by >1% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
